registration.created: Init only if constellation>=2; not created by an E cast

listenerFacts.baizhu.c2.trigger-actor-active: 0/1 from one ae.Info.ActorIndex == c.Core.Player.Active() comparison; when 0, returns before ICD read
listenerFacts.baizhu.c2.icd-active: 0/1 from one c.StatusIsActive(c2ICDKey) read, present only if actor fact=1

zeroAttackWhen: trigger actor is not current active actor

components.ordering: OnEnemyDamage is emitted after applyDamage, including any lethal OnTargetDied, and before native attack hit callbacks. It is suppressed as gameplay by hitConfirmBlocked EmitObserved; no listener call row is created then.
components.scopeGate: C2 event attack component can be certified independently of which active ally caused the trigger. At C6, Splice carries makeC6CB; shield creation/break/expiry and possible later Spiritvein remain an unclosed separate lifecycle, so do not mark that larger chain complete.

registration.created: Init regardless of constellation; not created by any Q cast

listenerFacts.tartaglia.riptide.target-enemy: 0/1 from original args[0].(*enemy.Enemy) assertion; when 0, returns before status read
listenerFacts.tartaglia.riptide.active: 0/1 from one t.StatusIsActive(riptideKey) read, present only if enemy fact=1

zeroProducerWhen: riptide status inactive on dead enemy
outcome.C2SideEffect: if constellation>=2, gain 4 energy during listener call; independent of attack producer

components.ordering: OnTargetDied fires inside lethal applyDamage before OnEnemyDamage and all hit callbacks. Manual KillEnemy emits with an empty AttackEvent; parent attack/dispatch identity must remain absent.
components.scopeGate: Listener call and +5f task/attack are a standalone event component. Parent lethal attack is the trigger, not the owner of the pre-existing riptide status. Enemy status ownership is not recorded by this ABI, so do not attribute burst to an earlier Q or claim full Q closure.
components.sourceImplementationNote: The code comment says Riptide Burst inflicts Riptide, but this queued attack has no applyRiptide callback; do not invent that status effect in the contract.

verificationBoundary: EventRegistration identity persists independently of per-cast roots.
EventEmission links only current trigger attack/target; it cannot establish source of prior enemy status.
A completed listener call with zero queued attacks proves only that this call took a zero-child branch.
A pending +5f event producer keeps its component open until the actual task and tagged attack complete.

patchStage.description: Patch applies before SourceHostTalentRead auto-instrumentation, so task and queue hunks use pre-instrument source context. Current Jv0OeE/pasFAn built caches are read-only audit evidence, not the patch application stage.

notes: Classic and stellar character-site patches are text-identical because these two audited listener bodies have the same pre-instrument patch context; latest built source hashes are lane-specific and recorded separately.

Patch labels callback at first body line, writes only facts from existing guard reads, and changes only the exact attack/task queue helpers; no callback wrapping, duplicate selector/status getter, or fabricated status owner.
Pre-instrument raw b4 upstream tree lacks these character files; classic patch applicability was checked against the actual GGPmB1 pre-instrument stage copy, not unrelated raw b4.
